name: Blank / Null-Bound level 3
summary: Blank / Null-Bound; You have advantage on saving throws against psychic powers and Perils effects. When a creature you can see within 30 ft gains Warp Pressure, you may use your reaction to reduce psychic damage dealt to one ally by your proficiency bonus.
